answer: A bridge market keeps an agent economy honest when each identity must earn a pearl pass by crossing a distinct bridge span before a distinct keeper who learns its face. The nth fake owes an introduction to every earlier identity, so the second owes 1, the third 2, the tenth 9, and the twentieth fake alone owes 19 live meetings while twenty fakes together owe 190. Bulk farming fails because one keeper greets one walker on one span and no crowd crosses as one person, like one saffron merchant weighing one thread at a time. Each greeting is earned fresh, never bought.
